chapters.title: Relativity
chapters.sourcePressure: Relativity is treated as a judgment model about vantage point, framing, incomplete information, and time horizon, not as technical physics.
chapters.coreMove: Change seats, inspect the frame, and widen the clock before trusting your first interpretation.
chapters.commonMisread: turning relativity into soft empathy or the claim that every viewpoint is equally true

chapters.title: Reciprocity
chapters.sourcePressure: Reciprocity is about actions creating reactions in iterative relationships, with positive first moves and forgiveness bounded by observed returns.
chapters.coreMove: Choose the move that teaches the next move to become more cooperative, then update on the response pattern.
chapters.commonMisread: turning reciprocity into abstract kindness, karma, or unconditional niceness

chapters.title: Thermodynamics
chapters.sourcePressure: Thermodynamics is about order, energy, entropy, drift, maintenance, and displaced disorder, kept practical rather than scientific.
chapters.coreMove: Price the maintenance energy a system needs before treating visible order as stable.
chapters.commonMisread: using entropy as a loose metaphor for messiness or complaining about decline

chapters.title: Inertia
chapters.sourcePressure: Inertia concerns people and systems continuing in their current direction unless a meaningful force changes the path.
chapters.coreMove: Identify what is already moving, then decide whether to interrupt, redirect, or use its momentum.
chapters.commonMisread: making the lesson a generic motivation speech about getting started

chapters.title: Friction and Viscosity
chapters.sourcePressure: Friction and viscosity explain how the surrounding medium slows movement and makes progress heavier than the objective itself.
chapters.coreMove: Separate useful resistance from avoidable drag, then remove the drag before blaming the goal.
chapters.commonMisread: calling every obstacle bad or treating speed as the only value

chapters.title: Velocity
chapters.sourcePressure: Velocity is speed plus direction; fast movement can be misleading if the heading is wrong.
chapters.coreMove: Judge motion by direction as well as pace, and stop rewarding speed that carries you away from the target.
chapters.commonMisread: celebrating urgency, hustle, or fast execution as progress by default

chapters.title: Leverage
chapters.sourcePressure: Leverage is about placement, structure, multipliers, and outsized effect rather than merely pushing harder.
chapters.coreMove: Move effort to the fulcrum where a small force changes the largest part of the system.
chapters.commonMisread: using leverage as a vague business synonym for advantage

chapters.title: Activation Energy
chapters.sourcePressure: Activation Energy explains why starting can require a threshold that continuing does not, so triggers and startup barriers matter.
chapters.coreMove: Design for the ignition threshold, not just the easier path after a change is already moving.
chapters.commonMisread: telling readers to want the goal more or to start small in a generic way

chapters.title: Catalysts
chapters.sourcePressure: Catalysts speed reactions without being consumed and can shift the path of progress instead of adding raw force.
chapters.coreMove: Look for a pathway changer that accelerates the reaction without becoming the fuel.
chapters.commonMisread: calling any helpful person a catalyst without showing the pathway change

chapters.title: Alloying
chapters.sourcePressure: Alloying focuses on complementary combination, resilience, flexibility, and useful mixed properties rather than purity.
chapters.coreMove: Combine unlike strengths so the mixture gains properties no pure element can provide alone.
chapters.commonMisread: making the point generic teamwork or diversity language without mixture-specific tradeoffs

chapters.title: Evolution Part One: Natural Selection and Extinction
chapters.sourcePressure: Natural selection and extinction are framed as differential persistence under environmental pressure, with extinction as the same logic in reverse.
chapters.coreMove: Test fitness against the environment that selects, not against abstract strength or past success.
chapters.commonMisread: turning selection into ruthless competition or survival-of-the-strongest slogans

chapters.title: Evolution Part Two: Adaptation Rate and the Red Queen Effect
chapters.sourcePressure: Adaptation Rate and the Red Queen Effect concern changing quickly enough while the landscape and competitors also move.
chapters.coreMove: Measure adaptation against a moving baseline, not against your own prior version.
chapters.commonMisread: turning the Red Queen effect into generic run-faster urgency

chapters.title: Ecosystem
chapters.sourcePressure: Ecosystem shifts the biology arc from isolated adaptation to interaction, interdependence, competition, and connected conditions.
chapters.coreMove: Map the shared environment and its spillovers before optimizing any single part.
chapters.commonMisread: using ecosystem as a fashionable word for network or community

chapters.title: Niches
chapters.sourcePressure: Niches follows Ecosystem and supports differentiated roles, position, specialization, and fit inside a shared environment.
chapters.coreMove: Find the role where fit improves because overlap decreases and specialization matters.
chapters.commonMisread: making niche mean personal branding or a narrow marketing segment

chapters.title: Self-Preservation
chapters.sourcePressure: Self-Preservation concerns survival, integrity, protective behavior, and defending essential conditions under pressure.
chapters.coreMove: Protect the conditions that keep the system viable before chasing expansion or approval.
chapters.commonMisread: treating self-preservation as selfishness or fear of change

chapters.title: Replication
chapters.sourcePressure: Replication concerns persistence through copying, transmission, reproduction, or passing structure onward.
chapters.coreMove: Preserve the working structure through transfer, not the surface ritual that merely looks copied.
chapters.commonMisread: equating replication with exact repetition or copy-paste sameness

chapters.title: Cooperation
chapters.sourcePressure: Cooperation is framed as coordinated action among multiple actors, including alignment, shared cost, and mutual outcome.
chapters.coreMove: Make mutual gain easier to coordinate than isolated effort or quiet defection.
chapters.commonMisread: turning cooperation into being agreeable or avoiding conflict

chapters.title: Hierarchical Organization
chapters.sourcePressure: Hierarchical Organization concerns nested levels, role layers, scale, and coordination through structure.
chapters.coreMove: Build layers that preserve coordination at scale without smothering local judgment.
chapters.commonMisread: assuming hierarchy is either always oppressive or always efficient

chapters.title: Incentives
chapters.sourcePressure: Incentives steer behavior through reward, penalty, signal, and consequence inside systems.
chapters.coreMove: Read the behavior the incentive actually buys, not the behavior the designer hoped it would buy.
chapters.commonMisread: treating incentives as bribes or simple motivation

chapters.title: Tendency to Minimize Energy Output
chapters.sourcePressure: Tendency to Minimize Energy Output is about lower-effort paths, effort conservation, friction, and environmental design.
chapters.coreMove: Make the lower-effort path serve the goal, because systems drift toward what costs less energy.
chapters.commonMisread: calling low effort laziness or worshiping harder work
